intro.text: A religious text that the Derethi still study alongside their own scripture, the Do-Dereth.
The holy book of Shu-Keseg, holding the teachings of the JinDo teacher Keseg. One of the oldest surviving works of Selish literature, it is still studied by the Derethi alongside their Do-Dereth.

description.text: Dilaf tells Hrathen that a Derethi arteth handed him both books, the Do-Dereth along with the Do-Kando, and that he got through them in one night.
Of Sel's surviving writings, only the poem Wyrn the King is thought to be older.
